title: After months of work, my mech shoot-em-up RPG is finally uploaded to reddit!
author: Revelation12Studios
selftext:
If interested, please check it out and let me know what you think.

[https://www.reddit.com/r/CoreOverride/](https://www.reddit.com/r/CoreOverride/)

Gemini 3 in AI Studio and Nano Banana was a huge part in the creation of this game.

comments.author: EnvironmentalPart750
comments.body:
İt's too hard from the start
Projectiles are so fast, you can't dodge them, where is the fun if you can't dodge them?

replies.author: Revelation12Studios
replies.body:
Gochya. Thanks for mentioning it. The idea is that it's an RPG-style combat, where you are allowed to be hit many times until you die, rather than once in a lot of other types of shoot-em-ups, therefore more projectiles are shot. Once you get leveling up and better gear it becomes less of an issue.  
  
I'll have to tone it down some, however.

replies.author: Revelation12Studios
replies.body: Alright. I changed it so the first few levels are easier: enemies shoot less and slower bullets. :)

comments.author: AgenticGameDev
comments.body: The controls felt sticky. No smooth movement... The framerate was laggy. Great effort though!

replies.author: Revelation12Studios
replies.body:
OK. Good to note. Thanks. If you’re on PC it’s easier to use the mouse to click and drag the mech around. 

May I ask what specs your PC hardware has?

replies.author: AgenticGameDev
replies.body: Using mouse. The craft got stuck when I moved mouse like it was not responding for 2-3 frames. But then I have been hunting frame drops a lot so they stick out for me. This was a lot more than one though and only on the craft so not a lag thing i think...

replies.author: Revelation12Studios
replies.body:
OK, yeah, I definitely see what you are saying about the lag. I am getting some lagginess on Firefox but it's completely smooth on Microsoft Edge.

What browser are you using?

replies.author: Revelation12Studios
replies.body:
Thank you for sharing all this information.

I updated the game and things should be much better in full screen mode.
